positive_terms: Disclosure of ecological thresholds identified and methodology used to identify ecological thresholds (pollution)
污染生态阈值及识别方法
Disclosure of ecological thresholds identified and methodology used to identify ecological thresholds (pollution)。污染生态阈值及识别方法。按目标、介质、物质、场址及期间保存。企业分配的阈值与环境整体生态阈值分开；法定目标和自愿目标必须由原文支持。
